question: The sum of all <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>3</mn></math>-digit numbers less than or equal to <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>500</mn><mo>,</mo></math> that are formed without using the digit <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>1</mn></math> and they all are multiple of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>11</mn><mo>,</mo></math> is ______.
solution:
209,220,231,........,495 series in A.P.

Clearly, a=209, d=220-209=11 and l=495

Where a is the first term, d is the common difference and l is the last term.

⇒l=a+n-1d=495

where n is the number of terms

⇒l=209+n-111=495

⇒n-111=286

⇒n-1=26

⇒n=27

Sum=2722×209+26×11=27209+143=27×352=9504

Numbers containing 1 at unit place =231, 341, 451

Numbers containing 1 at 10th place =319, 418

Hence, required sum of all 3-digit numbers less than or equal to 500=9501-231+341+451+319+418=7744
